status_vocabulary.bidirectional_merge: Requires complete native and application relation both ways for the claimed membership; none newly adopted.
status_vocabulary.directional_conditional: Requires closed native relation and actual enforced prerequisites for exact direction; saved Conditional is not that proof.
status_vocabulary.release_negative: Only exact adopted missing-input predicate members; never entire family from one failed member.
status_vocabulary.unresolved: Internal or delivery obligations remain; absence of a proof is not missing external input or physical impossibility.
status_vocabulary.native_zero_transfer: Complete decoded native identity permits a zero-action branch; current-device authority and explicit result remain unimplemented.
